goal: Fully programmable 2x2 MZI (theta, phi, a, b) with broadband couplers, grating couplers and eight bond pads in the open SiEPIC EBeam PDK

phase_shifters.phi: heater on the top input arm
phase_shifters.theta: PDK heater on the top MZI arm
phase_shifters.a: heater on the top output arm
phase_shifters.b: heater on the bottom output arm

four_fiber_ports.detail: 4 optical ports, pitches [127.0, 127.0, 127.0] um (expected 4 at 127.0 um)

eight_pads.detail: 8 pad openings; pads: {'pad1': 'phi terminal 1', 'pad2': 'phi terminal 2', 'pad3': 'theta terminal 1', 'pad4': 'theta terminal 2', 'pad5': 'a terminal 1', 'pad6': 'a terminal 2', 'pad7': 'b terminal 1', 'pad8': 'b terminal 2'}

heater_isolation.detail: 8 M2 nets, M1 pieces per net [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1], pads per net [1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1]; 4 heaters, nets per heater [2, 2, 2, 2]

layout_hygiene.detail: 0 heater pairs closer than 40.0 um; 0 silicon shapes under pad openings

gds_reproducible.detail: a fresh Python process regenerates a byte-identical GDS file

optical_ports_connected.detail: 132 optical instance ports checked in every cell; problems: none (layout/port_check.py)

limitations: Thermal crosstalk between heaters is not modelled (50 um centre spacing)
The fiber-array routes to the four grating couplers have different lengths; the resulting fixed phase between the inputs is absorbed by phi on calibration
SiEPIC's connectivity check finds no nets on this gdsfactory layout (its waveguides have no SiEPIC pins); optical connectivity is checked with layout/port_check.py instead
The broadband coupler's split has not been verified; ubcpdk has no compact model for it
The grating-coupler model in ubcpdk is a generic placeholder (6 dB, 35 nm), not measured data
Not submitted to or checked by the foundry
